outfit.name: 薄荷清透雪纺系带晨袍与脚链
outfit.prose: A gossamer-light semi-sheer pastel mint green chiffon robe tied loosely at the waist with a satin cord, revealing the silhouette of pale pink lace lingerie beneath. A delicate braided silver thigh chain with a tiny bell charm clings to her right thigh, paired with a thin silver ankle bracelet, barefoot.
